2. **TrafficPolicy Translation & Merging**:
   - Implemented [`consistentHashIR`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-gaxs2hev/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go#L20-L23), [`constructConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-gaxs2hev/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go#L100-L260), [`mergeConsistentHashIR`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-gaxs2hev/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go#L262-L317), and [`applyConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-gaxs2hev/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go#L319-L332) in [consistent_hash.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-gaxs2hev/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go).
   - Wired construction, validation, equality, per-route application, and policy merging with `consistentHash` merge origin metadata in [constructor.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-gaxs2hev/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/constructor.go), [traffic_policy_plugin.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-gaxs2hev/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/traffic_policy_plugin.go), and [`mergeConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-gaxs2hev/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/merge.go#L625-L663).

3. **Tests**:
   - Added unit and CRD validation tests in [consistent_hash_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-gaxs2hev/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash_test.go) and translator golden tests in [gateway_translator_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-gaxs2hev/pkg/kgateway/translator/gateway/gateway_translator_test.go#L790-L799).
